config.welcomeMessage: Hi! I’m the Vitaheal assistant. I can look up your order or subscription, or help you find the right product. What can I do for you?

entries.title: Returns and refunds
entries.text: You can return unopened products within 14 days of delivery for a full refund. Write to us first and we will send a return label. We refund to your original payment method within 5 business days of receiving the return.

entries.title: Money-back guarantee on Unwind
entries.text: If Unwind is not right for you, tell us within 30 days of delivery and we will refund your first can or bag. The guarantee covers your first order of Unwind, once per household.

entries.title: Privacy and your data
entries.text: We keep only what we need to deliver your order and look after your subscription: your name, address, email and order history. Your card details go straight to our payment provider and never reach us.

entries.title: Prices and payment
entries.text: Prices are in US dollars. You can pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.

entries.title: Delivery times and shipping cost
entries.text: Orders placed before 2 pm ET on a weekday leave our warehouse the same day. Delivery takes 3 to 7 business days, and shipping is free on orders over $50.

entries.title: Which countries we ship to
entries.text: We ship to the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia and New Zealand. Duties and taxes may apply outside the US.

entries.title: How subscriptions work
entries.text: A subscription sends your product at the interval you choose and saves 20% to 30% on every delivery. You can skip a delivery, pause or cancel at any time from your account page, before the next charge date.

entries.title: Contact and opening hours
entries.text: Write to hello@vitaheal.example and we answer within one business day. We are here Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm ET.

entries.title: Where our products are made and tested
entries.text: Everything is blended and packed in Sweden, and every batch is tested before it ships. Refills come in bags, so one can lasts for years.

messages.text: When is my next delivery?
Your Unwind subscription is active on the 3-month supply. The next delivery date is below, and you can skip it right here if you have enough at home.
No, that is fine. Thanks!
You’re welcome. Is there anything else I can help with?
I keep waking up at night. What do you recommend?
For better sleep, these are the ones we make for it: Unwind and Nasal Strips.
Is Unwind covered by the guarantee?
If Unwind is not right for you, tell us within 30 days of delivery and we will refund your first can or bag.
Do you ship to Canada?
We ship to the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia and New Zealand. Duties and taxes may apply outside the US.
Can I take Clear Focus with my blood pressure medication?
I can’t give medical advice. Please check with your doctor or pharmacist before starting a supplement.
